name: 33173 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33173 (Miami) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33173 (Miami) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33173 (Miami) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
